resources.string: Type or say what you spent, like "240 lunch". I file it for you.
Open Review when a payment needs a category. One tap each.
Ask me "how much on food this week" in chat. I answer from your own data.
Add a document and its dates. I remind you before it expires.
Save a new version and the old one stays in the timeline.
Ask me "when does my car insurance end" in chat.
Write anything. Tag with #tags and link notes with [[Title]].
Search finds words inside notes and pictures.
Set a reminder on a note and I bring it back at the right time.
I pair your days: sleep, steps, focus and screen time.
A pattern shows only when it is clear enough to trust.
These are hints, not rules. You decide what to change.
A goal takes weeks. Add milestones and link tasks to it.
Progress works itself out from what you finish.
Ask me "what is next on my goal" in chat.
